emit step and no build artefact to keep in sync with the sources.
`erasableSyntaxOnly` is what makes that safe rather than incidental: it refuses enums,
namespaces, parameter properties and anything else Node's stripper cannot erase, so a source
that type-checks is a source Node can run. Without it the failure would be at run time and in
`verbatimModuleSyntax` forces `import type` on type-only imports, which is the other half of
No `@types/node`: the three Node modules this package uses are declared in types/, so `tsc`
runs against the nix-pinned toolchain with no npm dependency and no network.
